answer: Sybil clones dilute epoch rewards by spinning cheap identities. Require each new worker to cut a crystal shard: stake 35 POA for 3 epochs into a prism escrow that splits release across 5 peer-chosen auditors. Auditors publish a pearl hash of the worker's first 12 verified work digests; peers refuse rewards until that hash matches the ledger. Cost is the locked 35 POA plus a 2-POA auditor fee. If two shards share >70% digest overlap within 48h, burn both stakes and ban the cluster for 2 epochs.
